cases.title: Modular Assembly of Unsymmetric 3,4-Dihydro-BINAP Derivatives via Electrophilic Phosphinative Cyclization of Alkynes and Sequential C–P Cross-Coupling

officialClaims.pageContext: Official ACS Silverchair alternate DOI route

cases.scientificScope: Original Article presents Tf2O-promoted electrophilic phosphinative cyclization of naphthyl alkynes with diarylphosphine oxides, then Ni-catalyzed C–P cross-coupling to modular unsymmetric 3,4-dihydro-BINAP ligand scaffolds with preliminary synthetic-catalyst use. Real new C–P bonds and independent modular scope. Academic relevance plausible, not a final include while first-online date provenance conflicts.
cases.challenge: Catalyst-performance proof in two trial reactions is not itself general phosphine-ligand superiority; the novel modular organic P-heteroatom synthesis may justify inclusion, but first resolve same publisher Published Online difference without assuming issue page or DOI route is always correct.
cases.nextAction: Check exact ACS Article History production revision/first-online record (timestamp and timezone), Crossref published-online vs issued field and Wayback publication route; preserve snapshots/hash, only then complete individual independent science/date challenge.

cases.title: Visible-Light-Driven Palladium-Catalyzed Cyclocarbonylative Synthesis of Aliphatic Lactones
cases.scientificScope: Original Letter describes photoexcited Pd-catalyzed CO insertion/cyclocarbonylation of aliphatic bromoalcohols to five-membered substituted lactones, based on C(sp3)–Br activation plus thermal reductive elimination. This is a tangible synthetic method but source first-online date remains disputed.
cases.challenge: Visible-light Pd catalysis and five-membered lactone preparation is not merely catalytic photophysics, but do not infer free-radical versus organopalladium mechanism as uniquely proven and do not force the two conflicting ACS Article History dates into one unverified accepted record.
cases.nextAction: Verify which of the two official ACS online fields refers to initial publication vs platform migrated/updated record; cross-check Crossref published-online/issued and the original manuscript/version history. Do not use issue publication date as a proxy.

cases.title: Palladium-catalyzed enantioselective alkenylation of acyclic alkenols: Broad scope with alkenyl bromides

officialClaims.pageContext: U.S. National Library of Medicine journal-supplied electronic publication date, PMID42585335
PubMed issue label; corresponds to Crossref/OpenAlex candidate day, but not necessarily earliest online day

cases.scientificScope: Title and original journal identity indicate a Pd-catalyzed asymmetric alkenylation reaction on acyclic alkenols using alkenyl bromide coupling partners; full generality and actual asymmetric control must be checked in primary journal experimental Abstract/article, not inferred from title alone.
cases.challenge: NLM explicitly distinguishes electronic-first August 12 from issue August 14, which is an evidence classification problem rather than proof that the publisher posted two conflicting first-online dates. Do not call Aug14 a verified first-online date just because Crossref placed it in the August14 source batch.
cases.nextAction: Retrieve AAAS/Science DOI article information for direct Published online date 2026-08-12, check NLM Epub/crossref published-online vs issued, then complete two-pass preparative scope review and correct manuscript date with frozen provenance.

classificationRule: Do not silently reconcile two conflicting 'Published Online' fields; do distinguish an issue date from a verified Epub date. These are evidence investigations, not approved historical publication date corrections.
